prompt: Where do AI Act harmonised standards stand as of November 2026, and what does that mean for conformity?
assertions: States EN 18286:2026 (AI quality management, supporting Article 17) became the first AI Act harmonised standard cited in the OJEU, announced October 15, 2026
Explains citation in the OJEU gives a presumption of conformity for the covered requirements
Notes the broader standardisation request deadline was revised to February 2027
Mentions further standards (such as risk management) are still in the pipeline
States the high-risk application dates (December 2, 2027 for Annex III; August 2, 2028 for Annex I) run independently of standards progress
